skills.name: Earth Shatter
skills.description:
After a 0.75s delay, Edith controls Phylax to launch an earth-shattering blow in a designated direction, dealing 225<font color='#47BE34'>( +10% Total HP)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit (deals 120% damage to Minions) and knocking them airborne for 1s.
This skill won't be interrupted by regular control effects (excluding Suppression).
skills.tips: Earth Shatter has a relatively long cast animation, thus it is recommended to couple it with Edith's teammate's control skill or cast it in a bush to increase the hit rate.

skills.name: Onward
skills.description:
Edith controls Phylax to charge in the target direction, dealing 90<font color='#47BE34'>( +3% Total HP)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies along the way.
If Phylax hits an enemy hero during the charge, it will stop immediately and throw them over its shoulder, dealing 108<font color='#47BE34'>( +5% Total HP)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>.
skills.tips: Onward is Edith's core skill. Use it to protect teammates or rip a tear in the enemy formation during the team fight.

skills.name: Primal Wrath
skills.description:
<font color='#404495'>(Passive:)</font> When inside Phylax, Edith can accumulate Wrath according to the damage she receives (calculated before damage reduction).
<font color='#404495'>(Active:)</font> Edith ejects herself forward from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. After that, she takes flight and can perform ranged Basic Attacks, each dealing 35<font color='#D58E1F'>( +75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+25% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font>. Edith also gains new skills in this state. When in flight, Edith gains 350<font color='#47BE34'>( +5% Total HP)</font>-350<font color='#47BE34'>( +20% Total HP)</font> extra Shield, 50%-150% extra Attack Speed and 5%-20% Hybrid Lifesteal based on the Wrath she accumulated, and converts each point of <font color='#47BE34'>(Extra Physical Defense)</font> and <font color='#47BE34'>(Extra Magic Defense)</font> into 3.2 <font color='#27C0C7'>(Magic Power)</font>. The flight state lasts up to 8s.

skills.name: Overload
skills.description:
After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become Overloaded for 3s, during which all Basic Attacks will trigger chain lightning, dealing extra <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> equal to <font color='#27C0C7'>( +30% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 4(+0.25*Hero Level)% of the target's Max HP to up to 4 enemies.
Chain lightning damage against Minions is increased to 150%.
skills.tips: Edith has the potential to overwhelm her enemy in the early to mid game. With her Passive Overload, she can clear the lanes and suppress her enemy with ease from afar while quickly leveling up to Lv.4.

items.name: Thunder Belt
items.des: Unique Passive - Thunderbolt: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 50 plus 5% of the hero's extra HP as extra True Damage to the target and enemies around them and slows them by 40%-80% (scales with the hero's extra HP) for 1s (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

items.name: Brute Force Breastplate
items.des: Unique Passive - Brute Force: Each second after dealing damage, gain 6 extra Physical Attack and Magic Power and 2% extra Movement Speed for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Gain 15% extra Control Duration Reduction at full stacks.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.des: Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: We recommend this build because Edith's extra Magic and Physical Defense would be converted to her Magic Power in her Marksman form, it is suggested to get a fair amount of Tank equipment for her.
